thought.text:
Skripnya aman — tidak ada yang aneh. Isinya: clone repo GitHub, copy `SKILL.md` ke folder skill agent, dan simpan API key ke `~/.config/ink/config` dengan permission 600.

Sekarang saya cek INK itu layanan apa dan apakah key kamu hidup.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && curl -s --max-time 30 "https://deployink.com/" | grep -oiE "<title>[^<]*|name=\"description\" content=\"[^\"]{0,180}|property=\"og:description\" content=\"[^\"]{0,180}" | head -4; echo "=== repo skill ==="; curl -s --max-time 30 "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mldotink/ink-skill/main/skills/ink/SKILL.md" | head -45

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && curl -s --max-time 30 \"https://deployink.com/\" | grep -oiE \"<title>[^<]*|name=\\\"description\\\" content=\\\"[^\\\"]{0,180}|property=\\\"og:description\\\" content=\\\"[^\\\"]{0,180}\" | head -4; echo \"=== repo skill ===\"; curl -s --max-time 30 \"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mldotink/ink-skill/main/skills/ink/SKILL.md\" | head -45", "summary": "Identify INK service and read its skill doc", "security_risk": "LOW", "timeout": 90}

summary: Identify INK service and read its skill doc
